english.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when “mean” identifies what something signifies or indicates, including an inferred meaning.

examples.english: I take this symbol to mean “Caution: slippery floor,” telling people to walk slowly.
examples.traditional: 我將呢個符號理解為小心地滑，即係叫人行慢啲。
